status: Protocol for fresh separate readings prepared; reader type awaiting user preference. Archival branch already exposed and explicitly exploratory.
question: Are the disputed graphic separations in f71r.13 and f71r.17 reproducibly perceived without candidate words or month labels? No linguistic boundary or translation assumed.
prior_exposure: Coordinator knows phase31 ZL/IT comparisons and has seen all images. GC published target rows were also viewed while preparing this protocol. These are not blind manuscript data.
archival_branch: Compare exact archived ZL/IT rows to attributed GC2a-n rows readable through the web tool. Retain v101 strings without automatic EVA conversion. Count explicit periods and uncertain commas only. This is comparison of published human-origin readings, not a newly commissioned or blinded human study. Do not vote corpora as statistically independent.
fresh_reading_branch: Three readers, each receiving only packet images/instructions/PANELS/response template and a distinct fixed order. If AI readers are chosen, use separate context with no conversation history, no exchanges, no web or repository searches. Same-model results remain correlated and non-human. There is no OS-enforced isolation or guarantee against training familiarity. If humans are chosen, prepare handoff without sending it to anyone.
independence_dimensions: instructions omit expected words, month and competing transliterations
no access to other responses requested
training or prior manuscript exposure cannot be excluded
shared photographs and coordinator selection remain dependencies
no independent human expert unless actually involved and documented
selection: Four exact PNGs from phase31, chosen for the two disputed boundaries and two same-section comparison inscriptions. Original failed crops excluded from packet; original files remain in phase31. Six presentations include two byte-identical repeats, never six independent observations.
image_policy: Copy existing exact-pixel excerpts only. No enhancement, inpainting, rotation, resampling, reconstructed letters or synthetic image output.

comparison_items.P42: f70v1.11; descriptive grouping only, no a/o adjudication
comparison_items.P93: f70v1.16; descriptive grouping only, disagreement at an additional final separator retained

classification: Only high-confidence clear gaps in the predefined window count as visible separation. A high-confidence graphic group enclosing both anchors with no gap in the window counts as single group at this image scale. All other cases are uncertain. Graphic classification is not a linguistic fact.
agreement_rule: Require all three first presentations to receive the same non-uncertain classification and all repeats to agree with their first presentation. Otherwise unresolved. No majority rescue, statistical significance or selected-reader exclusion. Repeated images check response consistency only.
response_integrity: Keep exact submitted JSON and written comments. Hash all responses before opening identities/transcriptions for confrontation. Later localization corrections are separate addenda; no silent edits or consensus negotiation.
missing_data: Do not produce AGREEMENT.json without three actual separate readings. Unavailable, unviewed, refused or unparseable readings stay missing. Never fill a response by simulating a human or another model.
stop_rules: No claim that visually separated groups are linguistic words
No claim that agreement gives a month meaning
No new contacts, publication or push
delivery: French result on published evidence, source/provenance ledger, anonymous reusable fresh-reading packet, complete actual reader responses if obtained, otherwise explicit pending status. Preserve earlier phases.
